summary: ChowChow Cloud International Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on October 20, 2026, attaching a press release issued in response to unusual trading activity in its ordinary shares on the NYSE American on October 19, 2026. The release is a no-news statement under Section 401(d) of the NYSE American Company Guide; the company states it made inquiries and found no material undisclosed development or other reason for the market action, and has not determined whether corrective actions are appropriate. No transaction, terms, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. What to watch: whether abnormal volume precedes disclosure of a corporate event.
